records.key: Apply current settings to all canvas images
records.source: Apply current settings to all canvas images
records.translation: 현재 설정을 캔버스의 모든 이미지에 적용

records.key: Update every canvas image when the Overview visualization changes. Turn off to keep each image's captured settings.
records.source: Update every canvas image when the Overview visualization changes. Turn off to keep each image's captured settings.
records.translation: Overview 시각화가 변경되면 캔버스의 모든 이미지를 업데이트합니다. 각 이미지에 저장된 설정을 유지하려면 끄세요.

records.key: Write every page to one PDF: vector text, images at full resolution with each image's captured display settings.
records.source: Write every page to one PDF: vector text, images at full resolution with each image's captured display settings.
records.translation: 모든 페이지를 하나의 PDF에 저장합니다. 텍스트는 벡터 형식으로, 이미지는 각 이미지에 저장된 표시 설정을 적용하여 전체 해상도로 저장합니다.
